summary: RE-VERIFICATION (frontend only, READ-ONLY on live prod DB) of the 5 fixes made after the §7 responsive sweep (iteration_56). Logged in as hostbay@moxx.co via the 2-step flow and probed real Playwright viewports (1920x1080, 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844) in light AND dark using getBoundingClientRect geometry, computed styles and WCAG contrast math. RESULT: ALL 5 FIXES PASS. FIX1 — at exactly 1024 the sidebar is now the 72px icon rail (data-sidebar-collapsed='true', width 72) and the dashboard right column (dash2026-fee-tier / dashboard-grow-panel) sits left 714 -> right 1001 inside the 1024 viewport with full text ('$100,000', '$72,879.79 to next tier', 'Reach Scale tier for 0.7% fees') and the 4th quick action ('Transactions') fully visible; identical in light and dark. FIX2 — at 390 on /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links, /settings in BOTH themes the avatar image measures left 316 -> right 340 (chevron ends ~356) i.e. fully inside 390; the company-selector-trigger shrinks to 48px ('hostbay') inside a minWidth:0/overflow:hidden wrapper; zero elements in the top 120px overflow the viewport; document scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390. FIX3 — landing at 1280: primary CTA 'Start free' is left 1140 -> right 1260 (fully visible, header scrollWidth == 1280, no overflowing header descendants) and the 'All systems normal' pill is display:none as intended; at 1440 the pill reappears (786 -> 937) and 'Start free' ends at 1424 <= 1440. FIX4 — /payment/failed at 390: 'Try again' and 'Return home' are stacked (top 500 vs 554), both 260px full-width of the card, no intra-button text wrap; verified light + dark. FIX5 — dark sidebar section labels ('Get paid'/'Money'/'Your setup'/'Account') compute rgb(161,161,170) on rgb(24,24,27) = 6.91:1, well above WCAG AA 4.5:1. REGRESSION: 1920 sidebar 324px, 1440/1280 sidebar 265px (collapsed=false), 768 rail 72px, 390 bottom tab bar visible + hamburger drawer opens (320px). No document-level horizontal overflow on /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links, /settings or landing at 1440/768/390 in either theme. Console was completely clean (0 errors) on every page visited this run.

ui_bugs.issue: Cosmetic/a11y only (NOT a regression): the now-stacked 'Try again' (37px) and 'Return home' (35px) buttons are below the 44px mobile touch-target minimum. Layout/fix itself is correct.

action_items: No action required for FIX 1-5 — all verified resolved with geometry + computed-style evidence.
OPTIONAL: dashboard quick-action buttons have no data-testid (had to match by text); adding e.g. data-testid="dashboard-quick-action-transactions" would make the 1024 clipping check assertable.

OPTIONAL (deferred backlog): §4.2 responsive table primitive, >=44px touch targets (incl. the two payment/failed buttons at 37/35px), scroll affordance on the settings rail and transactions source-chip row.
critical_code_review_comments: Containers/Client/index.tsx now uses '(min-width:768px) and (max-width:1024px)' — correct at exactly 1024, but the band is still expressed separately from the sidebar's own '@media (min-width:768px)' rule; centralise into one exported constant/hook to avoid the off-by-one returning.

CompanySelector wrapper relies on flex:'1 1 auto' + minWidth:0 + overflow:hidden on mobile; this works but the trigger text now silently truncates to ~48px at 390 (shows just 'hostbay'/icon) — confirm that is the intended affordance rather than an accidental collapse.
HomeHeader hides StatusPillWrap under 1360px via a hard-coded media query duplicated in two styled components; consider a shared breakpoint token.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed working recipes on this pod: (1) login as above with exact=True on Continue. (2) Theme is route-scoped: localStorage 'theme-mode-inapp' (dashboard family) / 'theme-mode-public' (landing, auth, payment result); set then reload — note the value persists across navigations in the same context, so set it explicitly before asserting a theme (my first 1024 run rendered dark for both passes because of a leftover value). (3) Landing needs wait_until='domcontentloaded' + 5-6s. (4) Clipping must be detected via child getBoundingClientRect().right vs viewport AND by walking ancestors for overflowX auto/scroll (a 'right beyond viewport' inside an overflowX:auto parent is scrollable, not clipped — this is the case for the settings rail and transactions source chips at 768). (5) The browser-automation tool's Python sandbox rejects str(), str.replace() and some f-string forms — build screenshot filenames from a precomputed list of names instead. (6) Verified geometry this run: 1920 sidebar 324, 1440/1280 265, 1024/768 rail 72, 390 bottom bar + 320px drawer; 390 header avatar 316->340; landing 1280 'Start free' 1140->1260; dark sidebar caption contrast 6.91:1. (7) NOT covered: /pay hosted checkout, /hostbay creator page, /invoices, /customers, /wallet (unchanged by these fixes).
rca_of_the_issue: All five iteration_56 defects were confirmed fixed at their stated root causes: the 1024 off-by-one was resolved by widening isTabletRail to max-width:1024px (rail restores 952px of content width, so the two-column dashboard grid no longer exceeds its overflow:hidden wrapper); the 390 header clip was resolved by making the CompanySelector wrapper flex:'1 1 auto' with minWidth:0/overflow:hidden so it absorbs the shortfall instead of pushing the avatar out; the 1280 landing CTA clip was resolved by reducing LeftGroup gap 72->36 and hiding StatusPillWrap below 1360px; payment/failed stacks via flexDirection column + width 100% on xs; sidebar captions now use text.secondary (#A1A1AA) giving 6.91:1 on #18181B.
